title: SourceRef
description: Exact evidence address: repository + full commit + blob + entry + half-open byte range + digest of the exact bytes returned.

entryId.description: Opaque id mapped to the verified Git tree entry. Not a path string.

displayPath.description: Presentation only. Never used for lookup or authorization.

byteRange.title: ByteRange
byteRange.description: [start,end) in bytes of the blob. end MUST be >= start; handlers reject inverted ranges with invalid_request.

lineRange.title: LineRange
lineRange.description: 1-based inclusive, presentation only. end MUST be >= start; handlers reject inverted ranges with invalid_request.

digest.description: sha256 of exactly the bytes in byteRange.
